Full-depth fan-out: family "Core documentation — harness capability, placement, activity, QL migration". Scene ids derive from the bound record paths; glyph terms are the bound records' own heading words. Presentation mappings are declared craft. Not corpus-complete claims beyond the frozen inventory: see the product receipt fulldepth-receipt-2026-09-21.md for exclusions and census-delta notes.

Enrichment 2026-10-06. Per-scene moves: 01-activity gathers (attract/implode — the portable reading gathers the native relation); a formation walks the doc's own relation Agency→Agent→Actuation→Stream→Activity. 02-harness-capability and 03-harness-reference hold (guard repel — contracts hold their edges). 04-ql-runtime-migration turns (vortex — the programme changes ownership boundary); the seam walks Agent→Runtime→migration. 05-system-placement emerges (the vertical composition disclosed); 06-visual-product-understanding marks (brighter gather — difference returns). 07-world-bound-root-agency settles; the constitutional relation walks World-bound→Agency→positional→Root.

3D: 05-system-placement; z is the doc's own vertical composition (Human authorship → O:I → Central → Root Agency → …) staged as depth layers; depthPerspective on. Pointer: the arc runs gather → guard → guard → vortex → stillness(emerge) → gather → settle(attract .16) — contracts guard, migration turns, the constitutional relation settles. Automation: circulation LFO on 01-activity (the stream keeps moving through surfaces).
